first_law.title: Latvijas Republikas Satversme (Satversmes Sapulces 1922. gada 15. februāra kopsēdē pieņemtā)

_law_titles.88967: Pārgrozījumi Latvijas Republikas Satversmes 74. un 79. pantā

_decisions: Satversme: the only archived capture of the 1922 base version (2021-11-13) reads "Valsts prezidents" in art. 52, where every later version and the 1993 official republication (Latvijas Vēstnesis Nr. 43, 01.07.1993) read "Valsts Prezidents"; the change shows on 1933-04-14 as an unexplained publisher change.

Satversme: the 1922 text is kept as likumi.lv gives it from 7 November 1922. Its operation was interrupted from 1934 and under occupation (1940-1990) and restored in full on 6 July 1993 (Likums par Latvijas Republikas Satversmes spēkā stāšanos un ievešanu); these events changed no words and are described in the README, not committed.
Satversme: the 1933 amending law (21.03.1933., arts. 74 and 79) predates vestnesis.lv; its title is the one likumi.lv gives and its publication day is left empty.
_decisions:20-darba-likums: DL: the 2002-06-01 text is the gazette publication (vestnesis.lv/ta/id/26019, Latvijas Vēstnesis Nr. 105, 06.07.2001). Its web copy differs from the oldest archived likumi.lv version (2003-01-01) in six articles only by spelling and typesetting (94: "pa-skaidrojumus"; 98: "piedāvātājiem"; 115 and 138: "jaunaka(s)"; 134: "pa-stāv", "pār stāvji"; 146: a missing full stop), with no note for that day; these show on 2003-01-01 as unexplained publisher changes.
DL: the EU directives reference block ("Informatīva atsauce uz Eiropas Savienības direktīvām") is editorial; its change on 2012-03-08 has no note and is an unexplained publisher change.
DL: law links on captures from about 2025 have the form /doc.php?id=<id> (the same id as /ta/id/<id>); they are read as law links for this act, so the law of 01.11.2018 (id 303008) is credited.
